visible_turns.text: Good evening , sir . I understand that you have been robbed .
Why didn't you report it before ?
Please tell me exactly what happened .
You should never open a door without looking to see who it is .
Did you get a good look at them ?
They don't seem to have done much damage to the flat .
My men began searching the area as soon as we received your call . I can't promise you that we'll recover your property but we'll certainly do our best .
